ja: 『宇宙戦艦ヤマト2202 愛の戦士たち』よりノイ・バルグレイが微細なマーキングを纏って登場！
• 形状、ディテールを優先したパーツ分割で造型。
• 赤色を基調とした本体は成形色で表現し、各所のマーキングは付属の水転写デカールにて美しく再現。
• 1/1000 ノイ・バルグレイを再現できるボーナスパーツが付属！
en: From "Space Battleship Yamato 2202: Warriors of Love", Noi Balgray appears wearing detailed markings!
• Modeled by dividing into parts with priority given to shape and detail.
• The main body, which is based on red, is expressed in molding color, and the markings in various places are beautifully reproduced with the included water transfer decals.
• Comes with bonus parts to recreate 1/1000 Neu Balgray!
